         message.  This document defines the following type codes:
requirements.condition: For the BGP header Type field
requirements.required_behavior: Use Type to indicate the message type code.
requirements.why_checkable: The parser dispatch and encoder type selection can be checked against the message kind.
OPEN encoding and type dispatch can be checked against code 1.
UPDATE encoding and type dispatch can be checked against code 2.
NOTIFICATION encoding and type dispatch can be checked against code 3.
KEEPALIVE encoding and type dispatch can be checked against code 4.
